# Claude Creative Skill Library

## The Claude Creative Skill Library.

Nine skills that turn Claude into your creative team. Claude is one of the best agents you can work with, it just doesn't know how to make content that performs. Every skill below gives it a creative director and writes every prompt for you, directly inside Claude Code.

> ⚡ **How it works, every time:** you describe -> Claude writes every prompt -> you paste them into the image and video generators you already use. No new subscriptions, no API keys, nothing to install.

---

## 🚀 Setup (same for every skill)

1. **Download** the folder under the skill you want, then **unzip** it
2. **Open that folder in Claude Code** as its own project: the desktop app, the terminal or the IDE extension. If Claude asks whether you trust the folder, say yes
3. Type the **`/command`** listed on the skill and follow along

> 💡 **Two things that save you a support message.** The skill sits in a hidden folder inside the download, so the unzipped folder looks almost empty. That is normal, just open the whole folder in Claude Code. And type the `/command` instead of describing what you want, that way Claude loads the full skill every time.

---

## Skill 1 · `/motion-design`

### Paper-Cut Motion

**Creates:** paper cut animations.

**Looks like:** your content inside a handmade paper world.

**Performs because:** it never feels artificial.

Drop in any image. Three prompts later you have a stop motion paper collage video where the whole scene builds itself out of torn paper, piece by piece. Two editions, pick one.

**Prompt mode.** Writes the three prompts, you run them in whatever image and video tools you already use.

---

## Skill 2 · `/ad-generator`

### Ad Generator

**Creates:** product advertisements.

**Looks like:** the static ads the big brands run.

**Performs because:** the template is proven, and it is filled with your brand's real colours, voice and product facts.

Pick from 40 battle-tested ad templates: headline, offer, testimonial, us versus them, before and after, press editorial and 34 more. Give it your website once and it builds your brand profile itself in about two minutes, then every prompt comes out pre-filled. Attach one clean product photo in your image tool, paste the prompt, generate.

---

## Skill 3 · `/ad-assets` then `/ad-director`

### The Ad Director

**Creates:** full brand commercials.

**Looks like:** your product getting the movie treatment.

**Performs because:** the same character, scene and product hold across every single shot.

Two skills, one pipeline. `/ad-assets` locks your character, your scene and your product. `/ad-director` breaks your ad into timecoded shots and writes a ready to generate prompt for every one of them, plus the end card. You never write a prompt yourself.

> 📌 Open the folder as one project. `/ad-director` reads the kit that `/ad-assets` built earlier in the same session, so the two skills have to run in the same folder.

---

## Skill 4 · `/ugc`

### PYNK AI UGC Studio

**Creates:** realistic AI characters.

**Looks like:** a real person filming a 15 second review of your product.

**Performs because:** it reads as a personal recommendation, not an ad.

Describe your creator, name your product, write what she says. You get the model prompts, the product and the scene locked, the full script and the final video master prompt. Attach your three images in order, paste the master prompt, and the ad is done.

---

## Skill 5 · `/image-prompter` then `/video-prompter`

### The Prompt Director

**Creates:** high converting ads.

**Looks like:** a film crew shot your idea.

**Performs because:** your character stays the same person in every frame.

Describe your model and get a locked headshot, an outfit and a six panel character sheet covering every angle. Describe a location and get a cinematic environment plate. Then hand both to `/video-prompter`, describe the moment, and get the video prompt for it.

---

## Skill 6 · say "let's make a video"

### Vox Animations

**Creates:** Vox style animations.

**Looks like:** your topic explained the way Vox explains things.

**Performs because:** curiosity drags people to the last frame.

One idea in, a finished narrated explainer out. Editorial collage or paper diorama look, a researched and fact checked script, a free voiceover, and the final cut assembled for you inside your session.

> ⚙️ First run only, for the voiceover and the final cut: Claude checks for two free tools, `ffmpeg` and `edge-tts`, and offers to install them for you. When Claude asks permission to run the narration command, say yes.

---

## Skill 7 · `/studio-shot`

### Studio Shot

**Creates:** clean product shots.

**Looks like:** your product on a clean studio background, shot by a pro.

**Performs because:** a clean packshot is the base every ad, listing and visual is built on.

Drop any photo of your product: an iPhone snap, a lifestyle shot, a messy desk. Pick a background colour and a format. You get one locked prompt that rebuilds it as a clean studio product shot, with your photo attached as the reference, so every colour, surface and word on the label stays exact.

> 🖼️ Built for GPT Image 2. If the label text comes out slightly off, just generate again, text varies between runs. Then take the result straight into Skill 8.

---

## Skill 8 · `/product-visuals`

### Product Visuals

**Creates:** cinematic product visuals.

**Looks like:** your product inside the campaign shot you have been saving on Pinterest.

**Performs because:** the scene sells the lifestyle while the product stays exact.

Drop your product and any scene you love. Two modes. **Recreate** places your product straight into that exact shot, same camera, same light. **Recompose** reads the scene and rebuilds it around your product. You get the prompt and the exact attachments, in the right order.

> 📌 A clean studio shot from Skill 7 gives the cleanest result. Built for GPT Image 2. Recompose varies more between runs, so generate two or three and keep the best.

---

## Skill 9 · `/claymation` `/paper-animation` `/song-style-ad` `/talking-object` `/skeleton-ads`

### Creative Formats

**Creates:** creative ad formats.

**Looks like:** five different ad formats, each one a look nobody scrolls past.

**Works because:** one locked style and one locked character carry through every beat.

Five formats in one folder: Claymation, Paper Animation, Singing Ads, Talking Object and Skeleton. `/claymation` and `/paper-animation` decide how the ad looks and hand you a numbered style menu to pick from. `/song-style-ad` turns your product into a micro music video with an original song. `/talking-object` gives a product, an ingredient or an organ a face and a voice. `/skeleton-ads` builds the "what happens if you ___" progression ad around one recurring 3D skeleton.
